snippet.title: Asteroid Requiem - Steam Trailer #1
snippet.description:
Asteroid Requiem – Now on Steam!

What if a rock could remember? What if a stone could long for home?

Embark on a poetic journey through space in Asteroid Requiem, an experimental game that blends minimalist physics-based gameplay with a reflective narrative. Drift through orbit and memory as a conscious asteroid haunted by the ruins of civilization.

🎮 Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3810870/Asteroid_Requiem/
